component.name: Where the Water Goes
component.summary: Live public U.S. water data as a living globe

description.p: An open-source screensaver and desktop visualization that turns public U.S. water data into a living globe: about 8,500 USGS stream gauges reporting right now, USGS rain gauges recording rain, lake and reservoir levels, and a river network over NOAA terrain. Every value shows where it came from and when it was observed.

Run it as an app, or with --idle to start fullscreen after a period of inactivity. If BOINC is running, it can show what your computer is contributing to volunteer research such as climateprediction.net.
Independent project, not affiliated with USGS, NOAA or NASA. Not a forecast or warning service.

screenshot.caption: Mississippi River Basin with live USGS gauges

description.p: First release: live USGS streamflow, rain and lake-level gauges; idle fullscreen screensaver mode; BOINC contribution status.
